name: Hokkaido University
tests: Japanese-taught degrees for privately financed international students require the EJU (Examination for Japanese University Admission) and Japanese proficiency, plus university-specific exams/interviews. English-taught undergraduate programmes (where offered) use document screening with standardized test results and English proficiency. No SAT/ACT requirement for Japanese-taught tracks.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Queen's University
tests: SAT/ACT not required. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 6.0); TOEFL iBT 88 (20+ each section) before Jan 2026, or 4.5 (no skill below 4.0) after; Duolingo 120; PTE 60.

name: Michigan State University
tests: Test-optional: SAT/ACT not required for admission or scholarships. English for regular admission: TOEFL iBT 79 (no subscore below 17) before 21 Jan 2026, or 4 (no section below 4, 3.5 speaking) after; IELTS 6.5; Duolingo 110. Lower scores may qualify for provisional admission with English study.

name: Emory University
tests: Test-optional for the 2026-27 cycle. English: no strict cutoffs, but recommended TOEFL iBT 100 (or 5.5 on the new scale), IELTS 7.5, or Duolingo; SAT EBRW 700+ or ACT English 30+ can also show proficiency. Optional InitialView interview.

name: University of Cape Town (UCT)
tests: Admission based on school-leaving results and UCT's eligibility rules for foreign qualifications; application fee R100 (SADC) or R300 (applicants from outside the SADC region).

name: Technische Universität Dresden
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

name: Universidad de Chile
tests: No SAT/ACT. Chilean students enter via the national PAES exam; foreign secondary-school graduates can use special admission routes. Teaching is in Spanish.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
tests: No SAT/ACT. Each bachelor's lists its own admission requirements (e.g. mathematics level) and English requirements for English-taught programmes under its 'Admissions' tab.
gpa_note: Diploma must be equivalent to Dutch VWO with required subjects; numerus fixus programmes add selection.

name: Tecnológico de Monterrey
tests: Academic Aptitude Test (PAA); native English speakers may submit SAT or ACT instead (Tec code 0843). English: Tec placement exam or TOEFL iBT, Cambridge B2 First/PET or Pearson certificate. Documents: birth certificate, transcript with GPA, passport or ID.

name: Curtin University
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification against course requirements. English proficiency required per course (IELTS/TOEFL/PTE or equivalent); portfolio entry is available for some courses.
gpa_note: Course-specific minimum results for your qualification.

name: Harbin Institute of Technology
tests: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/
gpa_note: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

name: National Cheng Kung University (NCKU)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement (results may strengthen an application). Chinese-taught programmes require Chinese proficiency (TOCFL); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Selection is by document review (transcripts, study plan, recommendations).
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: TU Wien (Vienna University of Technology)
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught in German: proof of German at A2 to apply and C1 before admission (the university preparation programme VWU can help). Some foreign certificates require supplementary exams; some programmes (e.g. informatics, architecture) have admission procedures.
gpa_note: Admission requires a recognised school-leaving certificate; selection procedures apply to some programmes.

name: Universitas Indonesia
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; international applicants are selected on school records and UI's admission tests/interviews. English-taught International Undergraduate Programs require TOEFL/IELTS; Indonesian-taught programmes require Indonesian proficiency. Minimum scores could not be verified.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: University of Bern
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's teaching is in German (except foreign-language studies), so proof of German is required; some programmes need Latin/Greek. Foreign certificates must meet Swiss recognition criteria. Medicine requires the Swiss aptitude test (EMS) via swissuniversities.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: University of Wollongong
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English: IELTS, TOEFL, Pearson, Cambridge and OET results accepted at each course's required level; previous study in English may also qualify.
gpa_note: Course-specific minimum results for your qualification.

name: University of Reading
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: e.g. Economics IELTS 6.5 with no component below 5.5; pre-sessional and International Foundation routes available.
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. BSc Economics: ABB (Maths preferred) or IB 32 with 5 in SL Maths.

name: Université catholique de Louvain (UCLouvain)
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mainly in French (some bilingual French/English), so French proficiency is required; foreign diplomas need equivalence from the French Community of Belgium. Medicine and dentistry require an entrance exam, and civil engineering a maths admission exam.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: University of Otago
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent) required for non-native speakers. Health Sciences First Year leads to competitive professional programmes (medicine, dentistry, pharmacy); entry to medicine also involves UCAT ANZ for most applicants.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Complutense University of Madrid
tests: No SAT/ACT. International applicants need Spanish university-access recognition (e.g. UNEDasiss accreditation, with PCE specific-competence exams to raise the admission grade) and then pre-enrol for each degree. Teaching is mainly in Spanish.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: King Abdulaziz University (KAU)
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement stated; Saudi applicants use national Qudurat/Tahsili tests. International scholarship applicants are selected on academic records and programme requirements. Many science, medicine and engineering programmes use English; others teach in Arabic.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: The Ohio State University
tests: ACT or SAT required for first-year applicants to the Columbus campus (superscored). English: TOEFL 79+ (before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.0+ (new), IELTS 6.5+, Duolingo 120+, ACT English 21+ or SAT EBRW 550+.
gpa_note: 50% of admitted students scored ACT 27-33 / SAT 1280-1470 ('Who gets in' page).

name: Waseda University
tests: Waseda accepts a wide range of standardized tests and school-leaving results: SAT, ACT, IB, A-level, Gaokao, GSAT, CSAT, HKDSE, AISSCE, Baccalauréat, Abitur and more. Required documents depend on the school and your education background.

name: Loughborough University
tests: No SAT/ACT for A-level/IB applicants. English: IELTS 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each element (some departments higher); TOEFL iBT 88 with 21 in each (pre-2026) or 4.5 (new scale); Duolingo 120 (speaking 110, writing 115, reading 110, listening 105).
gpa_note: Course-specific; e.g. Economics and Finance BSc: AAA, or IB 37 with 6,6,6 at HL.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (IIT-KGP)
tests: No SAT/ACT. B.Tech/B.S. admission at every IIT is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA seat allocation. Foreign nationals (and OCI/PIO cardholders from 4 March 2021 who opt for it) do NOT need JEE (Main) and may register for JEE (Advanced) directly; they compete for supernumerary foreign-national seats. Teaching is in English; no IELTS/TOEFL is required.
gpa_note: Admission is by JEE (Advanced) rank; foreign-national seats are allotted on merit among foreign candidates.

name: University of Bonn
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

name: Universität Hamburg
tests: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.
gpa_note: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

name: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU)
tests: SAT/ACT optional but strongly encouraged for engineering and computing. English: IELTS 6.5 overall or TOEFL equivalent.

name: Keio University
tests: English-taught programmes (PEARL in economics, GIGA at Shonan Fujisawa) use document screening with standardized test results (e.g. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level) and English proficiency; Japanese-taught programmes require EJU and Japanese proficiency with faculty exams. Exact thresholds are set in each programme's guidelines.
gpa_note: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name: Massey University
tests: No SAT/ACT requirement in general. English for undergraduate study: Academic IELTS 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each band (IELTS Online accepted), or equivalent TOEFL/Duolingo scores; some qualifications have higher requirements.
gpa_note: Entry by your secondary qualification (equivalent to NZ University Entrance); veterinary science and aviation are selective.
